description: Explore iNaturalist's full API, plus privacy-safe field briefings and identification progress that ordinary endpoint wrappers miss.

novel_features.name: Nearby highlights
novel_features.description: Get a transparent, recent wildlife briefing for an area without exposing observation coordinates.

novel_features.name: Nature scavenger hunt
novel_features.description: Create a factual, balanced nature scavenger-hunt checklist from taxa actually observed nearby.

novel_features.name: Current identification status
novel_features.description: See which of an observer's recent observations are identified, need IDs, disagree, or have no taxon.

novel_features.name: Identification changes since sync
novel_features.description: Report observations that became identified, changed, withdrew, or still need IDs since a previous privacy-safe sync.

novel_features.name: Seasonal shift briefing
novel_features.description: Compare two field windows and surface taxa that newly appeared, returned, or changed materially.
